item.title: Zero-Trust AI: Securing Sensitive Data Through Local-Only Processing (OCETA Lounge 2026)
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: A talk at OCETA Lounge detailing Zero-Trust AI architectures – processing sensitive biometric and telemetry data entirely on-device using Ollama and local open-weight LLMs.
